# Hamza Shaikh (@HamzaShaikhAI)

> Independent software developer and open-source builder creating Windows systems software (KeplerBridge D3D12-to-D3D11 compatibility layer for NVIDIA GeForce GT 740 and Kepler GPUs), local-first AI agent orchestration (AgentForge), autonomous video & motion graphics engines for AI agents (Remotion-For-Antigravity), and developer tooling.

## Primary Pages & Dedicated Guides

- [Portfolio Home](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/): Overview of Hamza Shaikh (@HamzaShaikhAI), Interactive 3D Systems Lab, audience workflows, flagship repositories, technical matrix, and FAQ.
- [KeplerBridge GT 740 / DirectX 12 Guide](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/keplerbridge/): Dedicated installation guide, GPU support matrix (GT 740 / GK107, GTX 750–780, GTX TITAN), shader cache benchmarks (~1.12 ms cold to ~0.03 ms warm load), and DX12 game compatibility notes.
- [Engineering Blog](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/blog/): Original architectural notes and technical deep dives on [DirectX 12 Agility SDK 1.620 & Enhanced Barriers](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/blog/2026-11-14-dx12-agility-sdk-enhanced-barriers-keplerbridge/), [Stateless MCP Agent Security](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/blog/2026-11-13-stateless-mcp-agent-security/), [Gemini 4 Hydrogen Sub-Millisecond Edge Agents](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/blog/gemini-4-hydrogen-sub-millisecond-edge-agents/), [Gemini 4 Carbon Agent Swarms](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/blog/gemini-4-carbon-agent-swarms/), [KeplerBridge DXIL-to-DXBC translation](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/blog/run-dx12-on-gt740-keplerbridge/) and [AgentForge MCP approval gates](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/blog/agentforge-mcp-approval-gates/).
- [Full Technical Profile](https://hamzashaikhai.github.io/llms-full.txt): Extended markdown knowledge base optimized for LLM context retrieval.

## Featured Open-Source Repositories

- [KeplerBridge](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/KeplerBridge): Open-source C++20 Direct3D 12-to-Direct3D 11 (`d3d12.dll` proxy) compatibility layer enabling DirectX 12 workloads on legacy NVIDIA Kepler GPUs (GeForce GT 740, GTX 750, GTX 760, GTX 770, GTX 780, GTX TITAN / GK107, GK104, GK208, Feature Level 11_0) via cleanroom LLVM 3.7 Shader Model 6.0 DXIL-to-SM 5.0 DXBC lowering (`v0.5.0-rc1`, Windows x64, MIT).
- [AgentForge](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/AgentForge): Local-first TypeScript 5.6 and Node.js (>=20) AI agent integration and workflow platform for Google Antigravity with MCP bridges, Manager UI dashboard, fine-grained permission gates, human approval checkpoints, and credential isolation (MIT).
- [Remotion-For-Antigravity](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/Remotion-For-Antigravity): Autonomous motion graphics, video editing & multimedia engine for Google Antigravity 2.0 AI agents. Programmatic React video generation, deterministic spring physics, bundled zero-config FFmpeg, lossless trimming & EBU R128 loudness normalization (`rea` CLI, MIT).
- [Notion Block Engine](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/notion-block-engine): Zero-dependency TypeScript 5.0+ (<15 KB) engine for bidirectional conversion and dirty clipboard HTML sanitization (Google Docs, MS Word) between HTML, GFM Markdown, and Notion-style Block ASTs (MIT).
- [VYDRIX](https://github.com/HamzaShaikhAI/VYDRIX): Archived C#/.NET Windows cloud-backed virtual storage experiment using WinFsp, preserved with a public technical post-mortem.

## Key Verified Facts

- Name: Hamza Shaikh (`@HamzaShaikhAI`)
- Collaboration Scope: Worldwide / Global Remote
- Primary Languages: C++20, TypeScript, Python, JavaScript, Dart, C#
- KeplerBridge Target Hardware: NVIDIA GeForce GT 740 (`GK107`), GTX 750, GTX 760, GTX 770, GTX 780, GTX TITAN (`GK104`, `GK208`, `D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0` / `0xB000`)
- KeplerBridge Drop-In Usage: Place 64-bit `d3d12.dll` + `kepler_bridge.ini` beside the game `.exe`; zero Windows system-file or driver modifications required.
